preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: The list p must contain n distinct integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for v in queries if v[0] == 1) and all(1 <= i <= m for i in queries if i[0] == 2)
preconditions.description: Queries of type 1 must specify valid vertices, and queries of type 2 must specify valid edges.

postconditions.description: For each query of type 1, the output must be the largest number p_u written on a reachable vertex.
After processing a query of type 1, at least one vertex must have its value set to 0.
The number of edges must decrease by the number of deletion queries processed.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n))
invariants.description: The values on the vertices must remain within the range of 1 to n.
The number of edges must not exceed the initial number of edges.
